dataset: ASTER Global Digital Elevation Model V003
coverage_note: This tile covers the main 54-55E, 29-30N project block. Adjacent tiles are still required for the full 28.6-30.2N, 53.3-55.2E screening envelope.
model_use: Topographic source only; derive slope, aspect and relief after CRS-aware preprocessing.
limitations: ASTER GDEM is a DEM, not mineral evidence.
No supervised model metric is justified by this tile alone.
No nodata filling or resampling was applied in this commit.
